title: Cobblemon Artichoke
description: Cobblemon with fun add-ons, QOL improvements
body:
**Cobblemon Artichoke** is a new Cobblemon modpack made with intent to fill a gap in the Cobblemon modpack scene.

-Automate and innovate with Create mod
-Resources made easy with Botany Pots (including minerals)
-Build your own cars with Automobility
-Store it all in Storage Drawers
-Progress through Cobblemon with Radical Trainers
-Play cards with friends with Charta
-Mine whole veins and chop whole trees

_and much more_

This modpack was inspired by my time playing "kitchen sink" style modpacks, and is aimed toward those wanting to host small servers for friends. It includes chunk claiming/protection as well as some tools for administrators. The typical Minecraft progression system is broken, ores can be grown in pots, and you might feel overpowered. I did this to put the attention of the bread and butter of this pack, Cobblemon and Create.

If nothing else, this is a fun introduction to both Create and Cobblemon, allowing you to immerse yourself in both without hours of farming.

All Vanilla minecraft mobs besides villagers have been disabled to keep the spotlight on Cobblemon. Recipes have been adjusted appropriately.


!!!

All credits remain with mod authors. Thank you so much for what you do for this game. 

!!!
